skills.name: Composite - Apply and spread mixture to a surface
skills.description: Use a tool to apply and spread mixture on a surface.

steps.activity: Take a scoop of mixture on the tool
Determine the position on the surface where the mixture will be applied
Position the tool at the application location on the surface
Swing the tool to apply the mixture to the surface
steps.category: Swing arm while holding an object

steps.activity: Rub the tool on the surface to spread the mixture

examples: Apply and spread mortar on a wall with a trowel
Pack mortar into a brick joint with a flat pointing iron

skills.name: Composite - Apply a liquid to a surface with a brush or roller
skills.description: Use a brush or roller to apply a liquid to a surface.

steps.activity: Determine the position on the surface where the liquid_to_apply will be applied
Position the application_tool near the location on the surface
Stroke the application_tool to apply the liquid_to_apply to the surface

examples: Apply paint to a wall with a brush

skills.name: Composite - Dip a brush or roller into a liquid and apply it to a surface
skills.description: Dip a brush or roller into a liquid and use it to apply the liquid to a surface.

steps.activity: Dip the application_tool into the liquid_to_apply
steps.category: Move tool along a linear path

steps.activity: Apply the liquid to the surface with the application_tool
steps.category: Composite - Apply a liquid to a surface with a brush or roller

examples: Dip a paintbrush into paint and apply it to a wall

skills.name: Composite - Apply paste from a gun or tube
skills.description: Apply a paste from a gun or tube to a surface or joint.

steps.activity: Position the application_tool on the surface
Press the plunger of the gun or press the tube to dispense the paste_to_apply

examples: Apply construction adhesive to a wall panel with a glue gun

skills.name: Composite - Apply paste from a gun or tube along a line
skills.description: Apply pasten from a gun or tube to a surface or joint.

steps.activity: Apply the paste_to_apply to the surface with the application_tool
steps.category: Composite - Apply paste from a gun or tube

steps.activity: Move the application_tool along the surface to apply the paste_to_apply
steps.category: Move tool along a linear path

examples: Apply caulk to a joint between two surfaces with a caulking gun
Apply sealant to a surface with a tube of sealant

skills.name: Composite - Mask a surface for painting
skills.description: Position and secure masking material over a surface or component and seal the edges to protect the covered area during painting.

steps.activity: Determine the extent of the surface_to_protect
Position an edge of the masking_material
Pull, unfold, or spread the masking_material across the surface_to_protect
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Position the masking_tape along the edges of the masking_material
Press the masking_tape along the masking_material edges
Inspect the covered area and sealed edges for gaps
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

examples: Cover a window with masking film and painter's tape before spraying
Protect an open electrical box and conductors from paint overspray

skills.name: Composite - Mask a surface with an adhesive masking material
skills.description: Position and secure an adhesive masking material over a surface or component to protect the covered area during painting.

steps.activity: Determine the extent of the surface_to_protect
Position an edge of the masking_material
Pull, unfold, or spread the masking_material across the surface_to_protect
steps.category: Pull or push an object with arm

steps.activity: Press the masking_material on the surface_to_protect to secure it
Inspect the covered area and sealed edges for gaps
steps.category: Inspect to check state or find issues

examples: Cover painted stripper with laminated stripping paper to accelerate curing
